what_it_is.prose: Maxar Intelligence supplies high-resolution Earth observation satellite imagery to Indian government customers including the Indian Army, NTRO, and ISRO under commercial contracts. Maxar's WorldView and GeoEye constellation imagery has been used for Indian border surveillance, infrastructure monitoring, and disaster response. Maxar was acquired by Advent International in 2024 and delisted.
